Varun Mehta
DevOps Engineer | Hyderabad, Telangana
varun.mehta846@example.com | +91 9884402686

Result-driven DevOps Engineer with a focus on cloud-native infrastructure, automation, and reliable CI/CD pipelines. Strong track record of reducing deployment times and improving system availability through Kubernetes orchestration, infrastructure as code, and containerization. Seeking to apply automation and cloud skills to scalable production environments.
Notice period: 90 days

Experience

NimbusSoft — Feb 2026 - Present
DevOps Engineer, Remote
- Implemented Kubernetes cluster provisioning and lifecycle automation using Terraform and K8s modules, reducing cluster setup time by 70% and standardizing environments across staging and production.
- Hardened Linux-based node images and automated patching workflows, cutting security-related incidents by 40% and lowering mean time to recovery for node issues.
- Built Terraform modules for networking, IAM, and compute resources on AWS, enabling repeatable infrastructure deployments and decreasing manual configuration errors by 85%.
- Designed and operated CI/CD pipelines that leveraged Docker images and CI/CD tooling to achieve zero-downtime deployments for three critical services, improving deployment frequency by 3x.

GreenGrid — Feb 2023 - Jan 2026
Cloud Engineer, On-site
- Migrated microservices to K8s with Dockerized workloads and Helm charts, improving resource utilization and reducing average service start time by 55%.
- Authored Terraform templates to provision AWS infrastructure (VPCs, subnets, autoscaling groups) and implemented state management, reducing provisioning time for new environments from days to hours.
- Administered Linux servers for build and runtime environments and implemented automated health checks, lowering incident rates related to configuration drift by 60%.
- Integrated CI/CD pipelines that automated image builds, tests, and deployments, resulting in a 40% decrease in lead time for changes and more reliable release cadence.

Projects

- Built a tool to analyze Kubernetes resource usage and recommend pod resource adjustments; produced weekly reports that demonstrated potential cost savings of 18% in test clusters.

CI/CD Starter Kit — Personal project
- Created a reusable CI/CD template using Docker and pipeline scripts to standardize builds and deployments for small teams, cutting onboarding time for new projects.
